entries.name: Dark Elves
entries.content:
Dark elves are a species of dark-skinned, pointy-eared humanoids who live in a heavily misandrist and matriarchal society.

The dark elf women are typically stronger than the makes. The society views men in the way that most medieval human societies viewed women, chiefly that wonen lead the household and provide while men do the menial work and are subserviant to the women. Men are often married off to other nobles for political reasons and treated far worse than the women.

Dark elves are heavily sadistic, hedonistic and very big on social darwinism. They feel that life should be filled with pleasure, all the better if it comes at someone else's expense and those who cannot resist their torment don't deserve the priviledge of being treated fairly. Prisoners, especially men, are treated as sex slaves and exploitable labor by the dark elven women who lead the society.

entries.name: Olga Discordia
entries.content:
Olga Discordia is the queen of the dark elves in the nation of Avarice.

She has long, raven black hair with bangs that cover one eye. She has dark chocolate colored skin. Olga is proficient with a wide manner of powerful spells and prefers to fight with magic.

Chloe idolizes Olga as the stoic, composed, regal icon of what a dark elf should be. Chloe will do whatever Olga says and often go out of her way to please her stoic queen. Chloe is much more loud, talkative and energetic while Olga is quiet, composed and minimalistic. Chloe will exert more force than required to please her queen while Olga uses precisely enough force to decisively dominate a situation.
